evidence.citation: "One passing rerun does not prove the skill. Because the case matters and the conclusion is categorical, run it 2–3 times and report a per-case pass rate, including cited gaps for any misses."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact’s additional execution work is tied to reproducibility and regression verification before concluding the skill is proven or an edit is acceptable. Under the supplied bar, repeated runs and rate reporting for that purpose are necessary controls, not materially unnecessary work.
